patthana15.1:2.1: hetuṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na hetuṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: hetuṃ kusalañca nahetuṃ kusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. cittasamuṭṭhānameva ārammaṇaṃ natthi.
patthana15.1:3.1: hetuyā tīṇi adhipatiyā tīṇi avigate tīṇi.
